name: Vvakta IX
source:
Join the space exploration team of Telphedice, a goblin whose appetite is only matched by her greediness.

Try to balance discovering all the secrets of the mysterious oceanic planet Vvakta IX and supplying her with enough food to satisfy her demands! 

[From [url=https://phatelot.itch.io/vvakta-ix-public]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入特尔菲迪丝的太空探索队，特尔菲迪丝是一个胃口与贪婪相匹配的妖精。

尝试平衡发现神秘海洋星球Vvakta IX的所有秘密和为她提供足够的食物来满足她的需求！

[来自[url=https://phatelot.itch.io/vvakta-ix-public]itch.io[/url]]
